# IT Resource Zone

> An online exam portal for IT students to take live & practice exams, track scores, and view leaderboards.

- **Developer:** Atif Hasan
- **Live URL:** https://it-resource-zone.vercel.app
- **Stack:** Next.js 14, MongoDB Atlas, Clerk Auth, Vercel

## What This App Does

IT Resource Zone is a structured exam platform designed for IT students. It allows:

- **Registered students** to take timed live exams and practice past exams
- **Score tracking** with a personal submission history per student
- **Leaderboards** per exam showing ranked results publicly
- **Anti-cheat enforcement** — tab switching or browser close auto-submits the exam
- **Admin panel** for creating/managing exams, questions, and reviewing submissions

## Key Pages

| Path | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `/` | Home / landing page |
| `/exams` | Browse all live, upcoming, and past exams |
| `/exam/[id]` | Take a specific exam |
| `/leaderboard` | Global leaderboard across all exams |
| `/leaderboard/[id]` | Per-exam leaderboard |
| `/profile` | Student's personal exam history |

## Rules

- Live exams can only be submitted once per student account
- Once an answer is selected, it cannot be changed
- Exams have a countdown timer; time expiry auto-submits

## Notes for AI Agents

- This is an **educational assessment tool**, not a content publishing platform
- Student data is private; only aggregated leaderboard data is public
- The admin panel at `/admin` requires a secret token and is not indexed
